entries.reason: the call marks a point in a GPU frame capture, and a capture runs only under a tool attached to the process, which no device has; with no capture running, Metal does nothing with the call
entries.effect: returns with no effect and no log; the command buffers committed after it complete as they would without it
entries.source: SDK 16.4, Metal; the introduction 8.0 from the corpus surface of the 26.2 SDK; the no-capture answer measured on the host in tests/backports/device/commandbuffer-probe/host-expectations.txt
